notes: TIER: robots.txt (fetched via browser after HTTP tier 1 was hard-blocked - see below) carries no Claude-specific disallow and no site-wide 'Disallow: /' (only blocks /my-account, /cart, /checkout, /search, /api, PDP variant-param URLs, and named bad bots CazoodleBot/MJ12bot/dotbot/Gigabot) - explicit permission for a real browser. TIER 1 (direct HTTP via curl/WebFetch) hit a hard Akamai 403 on every URL including robots.txt itself (generic bot wall, not Claude-specific) - moved to TIER 3 (Claude-in-Chrome) per the hard-block rule since no Playwright/CDP tool was available in this environment; robots.txt was then read successfully through the real browser. Scope: strictly the Home & Kitchen department per task instructions (AJIO is a large fashion+home marketplace; Men's/Women's fashion, Beauty, Kids etc. excluded). MEGA-MENU DISCOVERY: read the full Home & Kitchen taxonomy from the site's own navigation (Cushions & Pillows, Kitchen & Dining, Decor & Gifting [Wall & Table Decor, Showpieces & Figurines, Stationery & Organisers, Festive Gifts, Gardening & Planters, Home Fragrances, Lighting, Mirrors, Photo Frames, Vases, Table Accents], Bath & Laundry, Furniture, Home Needs, Kitchen Appliances). Exactly ONE genuine holiday/seasonal taxonomy node exists in this tree: 'Festive Gifts' - own URL (/home-kitchen-festive-gifts/c/831203004), own breadcrumb (Home > Home & Kitchen > Decor & Gifting > Festive Gifts), own displayed total ('1,464 Items Found'), and listed as a first-class sibling category alongside Wall & Table Decor/Lighting/Showpieces & Figurines in the Decor & Gifting category filter (confirmed by visiting the Decor & Gifting parent PLP, 134,642 items, and its own Category facet list). AMBIGUITY (flagged, not silently decided, per SKILL.md SS4): 'Festive Gifts' is a genuine stable PLP, not a marketing/sale page - but its product mix is NOT cleanly attributable to one holiday. Majority theme is Diwali/pooja (diyas, brass aarti diyas, torans/bandhanwar door hangings, rangoli-style wall stickers, evil-eye door hangings, Ganesha/Krishna/Lakshmi idols, scented Diwali candles), with a secondary genuine Christmas theme (tree skirts, wreaths) also present, plus non-seasonal general-gifting merchandise mixed in (chandeliers, table lamps, jewellery boxes, analogue-watch-and-wallet combo sets) that has no holiday association at all. Rules SS3 explicitly warns 'do not assume every Festive category means Diwali' - this site genuinely does not resolve the ambiguity (no on-page H1/banner naming a specific festival, no 'Occasion' facet on this category's own PLP to sub-divide it, title is the generic 'Festive Gifts - Low Price Offer on Decor Kitchen Festive Gifts Online'). Kept INCLUDED (not excluded) because it passes every other prong of the SS20 test (real PLP, real category not marketing, own URL, own qty+evidence) and the site itself brands it festival-specific rather than folding it into plain 'Decor & Gifting' - but flagged MANUAL REVIEW rather than assigned a confident single-holiday category name, consistent with the project's SR165 Noon UAE precedent for a generic multi-holiday label. EXCLUDED: '/search/?text=diwali decor' and '/search/?text=christmas decor' - both are search-results pages (title 'Best Offers on ... upto 20-71% off - Limited period sale'), explicitly disallowed by AJIO's own robots.txt (Disallow: /search, /*/search/*), and each aggregates hits from multiple pre-existing categories (Wall & Table Decor, Showpieces & Figurines, Festive Gifts, Home Fragrances, Rakhis) rather than being a real taxonomy node - the same search-driven-marketplace pattern flagged in the task brief (c.f. Etsy). No dedicated Christmas, New Year, Holi, Eid, or Raksha Bandhan category node exists anywhere in the real Home & Kitchen navigation (checked the full mega-menu tree exhaustively - none present as a first-class category, only reachable via the disallowed search). 'Rakhis' exists as a real category but only under Men's/Women's Accessories > Fashion Jewellery (fashion department, not Home & Kitchen) - out of scope per the task's explicit Home & Kitchen-only scoping, so not included even though Raksha Bandhan is otherwise an in-scope occasion. Mother's Day / Father's Day: checked the mega-menu and Decor & Gifting facet list - no such node exists in Home & Kitchen; genuinely absent, not overlooked.

rows.flag: ADJUDICATED KEEP: genuine PLP/category (real breadcrumb, own URL, own displayed qty), and the sampled content is majority genuinely Diwali/pooja-themed (diyas, torans, idols, scented candles); but a genuine secondary Christmas theme and some non-seasonal generic gifting are mixed in under the same node with no on-page Occasion facet to split it -- the single-holiday attribution is irreducibly ambiguous, kept as a permanent judgment call rather than assigned a false-confident single holiday.
